instances.name: subr_SW
instances.note: SU quarter SW multirate bridge epoch release (closes G-SU-BRIDGE-EPOCH-SW): serial pin register of su_prog.busy at the common edge E0-12q, three stream stages, bridge_rst_n deasserts at stream edge E0-3q (last stream edge before E0); sticky; later starts checked for the same epoch phase (fault). 6 flops + 2-bit phase counter; pin-registered in and out. No slot: place beside sucore (H-DIE).
